text:
sophie - Support: Hey infra team — MedAlign (enterprise trial) is running a DR failover test and is hitting admission-control in eu-north. They need a temporary quota uplift for GPUs to avoid ~15% request drain during the next 24h window. Can we do an override?
aj: Can you paste the account ID, expected concurrent jobs, and what GPU type they need?
sophie - Support: account: MA-9982, they'd like to run on a mix of a100-80g and a10g, target concurrent model sessions = 48, average session length ~90s, peak qps ~120. This is for a compliance DR run (not a demo) — sales flagged SLA risk.
maria (SRE): current eu-north pool is ~92% utilized in sustained windows. If we lift, we'll need to pin them to a preemptible burst lane or add soft-eviction hints. Do they accept preemption?
Liam G: Sales confirms they do NOT accept preemption for this run — contract contains a short window SLA clause. We need a non-preemptible short-term reservation if possible.
oncall-bot: cluster-metrics eu-north: GPU utilization 92.3% (1h avg), queued requests 64, admission dropped 14 in last 10m. Node autoscale headroom: ~5 nodes provisioning ETA 18m.
aj: Non-preemptible reservation for 48 sessions ~= 6 additional a100-equivalent GPUs for the time window. We can provision but it's going to require capacity rebalancing or borrowing from west2. Need explicit approval from finance if >$X/day.
sophie - Support: Finance flag: override approved up to $2.5k/day for emergency remediation. Sales will cover overage.
maria (SRE): Two options: 1) soft-override: give them burst reservation that can be throttled if cluster drops below 80% (safer), or 2) strict-reservation: cordon 6 GPUs for 24h, evict low-priority tenants. Which do they want?
Liam G: Must be strict-reservation for contract reasons. We should minimize eviction impact though — target eviction of lower-priority trial accounts only.
aj: I'll open a provisioning request and a temporary rate-limit exception. Steps: (1) File internal ticket ENG-INF-5421 with account + cost center, (2) provision 6 a100-equivalent non-preemptible units in eu-north, (3) apply per-account admission-control rule: max-concurrency=48, burst-window=24h. ETA ~30m to start provisioning after ticket.
sophie - Support: filing ticket now — ENG-INF-5421 created. I've attached billing approval and contract snippet.
billing-bot: Billing note: override charge code OVERRIDE-MA-9982, cost center SALES-EMERGENCY.
oncall-bot: Provisioning job started: job_id=prov-8772, nodes requested=6, eta=22m. Logs: `provision: requesting 6 x a100-80g in eu-north`
maria (SRE): I'll monitor admission-control and set a temporary SLO exemption for that account. If we see cluster risk >95% we'll throttle back.
aj: Confirmed — setting non-preemptible reservation and admission rule. Will update thread when nodes are up.
sophie - Support: thanks everyone — please @me when it's live so I can notify the customer. :thumbsup:
aj: nodes are reporting ready in eu-north. Starting network overlays and model warmup (warming caches).
oncall-bot: Provision complete: prov-8772 -> 6 nodes ready, 6 GPUs available.
maria (SRE): verification: cluster queue drained by 70% for MA-9982, no impact to high-priority tenants detected so far.
Liam G: Customer notified, they say failover run starting now. Keep monitoring.
sophie - Support: closing loop after 24h window. Appreciate the fast turnaround. :rocket:
